purpose: The frame of a page: optional header, side navigation and footer around the one main landmark, with a skip link.

props.name: header
props.description: The page header, usually an AppHeader

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer content, such as legal links; wrapped in a footer landmark

props.name: background
props.description: page (default) or sunken, which makes surface panels stand out

props.name: skipLinkLabel
props.description: Text of the skip link; defaults to Skip to main content

props.name: children
props.description: The page content, rendered inside main

whenToUse: As the root of every full page that has no page template
Inside page templates, which build on it
whenNotToUse: Inside a Modal, Drawer or Card
More than once on a page — there is only one main
antiPatterns: Two main landmarks on one page
Screens with a bare stack of fields and no page frame

sizes: Main padding `space-layout-section` block, `space-layout-page` inline; footer padding `space-component-padding-md`; main narrows to `size-container-sm` before nav wraps
states: Background `color-background-page` or `color-background-sunken`; skip link `color-interactive-default` with `color-text-inverse`, focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`

a11yNotes: One main landmark; header, navigation and footer are landmarks
With a header or nav, a skip link is the first Tab stop and moves focus to main (WCAG 2.4.1)
